title: Logical Reasoning
description: Class 2 IMO — Logical Reasoning: odd one out, analogy, number and figure series, coding-decoding basics, and position/ranking puzzles for the Maths Olympiad.

topics.title: Odd One Out, Grouping & Analogy
topics.concept: In odd one out, three items share something and one does not — pick the different one. In grouping, we collect things that belong together. An analogy shows a related pair, then asks you to complete a second pair the same way: cow is to calf as dog is to puppy.

examples.problem: Odd one out: rose, lily, lotus, mango.
Big is to small as tall is to ___ ?

recap: Odd one out = the one that is different.
Analogy = find the link in the first pair, then match it.

quiz.explanation: 7 is odd; the others are even.

quiz.q: Hot is to cold as day is to ___ ?

topics.title: Number & Figure Series
topics.concept: A series follows a rule. In a number series, find how each number changes (add, subtract, or double). In a figure series, look at how the picture turns or grows. Find the rule, then choose the next item.
recap: Figure series: spot turning or growing.

topics.title: Position, Ranking & Simple Coding
topics.concept: Position tells where something is (top/bottom, left/right). Ranking tells the order in a line (1st, 2nd, 3rd…). In simple coding, a letter or sign stands for something else, and we use the rule to decode.

examples.problem: In a line of 5, who is in the middle?
If CAT is written by moving each letter forward by 1, what is the first letter's code for C?
examples.solution: D — C becomes the next letter, D.

recap: In coding, a rule changes letters/signs — use the rule to decode.

quiz.q: 7 children stand in a line. Who is exactly in the middle?
quiz.explanation: With 7 in a line, the 4th is in the middle.

quiz.q: If A = 1 and B = 2, then C = ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Letters in order: A=1, B=2, C=3.

questions.q: Odd one out:  cricket, hockey, football, guitar.
questions.explanation: Guitar is a musical instrument; the others are sports.

questions.q: Finger is to hand as toe is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Fingers are on a hand; toes are on a foot.

questions.q: Continue:  Z, X, V, ___ (skip one letter back each time)?
questions.explanation: Going back skipping one: Z, X, V, T.

questions.q: Which does NOT belong with circle, square, triangle?
questions.explanation: A spoon is not a flat shape; the others are shapes.

questions.q: Day is to week as month is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: Days make a week; months make a year.

questions.q: In a race of 6 runners, Sara is 2nd. How many runners are behind her?
5 books are stacked. The maths book is at the bottom. What is its position from the top?
questions.explanation: The bottom of 5 books is the 5th from the top.

questions.q: A bag has 3 apples, 2 mangoes and 1 ball. How many fruits are in the bag?
questions.explanation: Fruits = 3 apples + 2 mangoes = 5 (the ball is not a fruit).

questions.q: Children stand in a line. Riya is 3rd from the front and 4th from the back. How many children are there in all?
If each ☆ stands for the number 2, what number does ☆☆☆ stand for?
